Local CPU only; up to 10 steps, 2 retries per step, 512 requested output tokens per attempt, and 30 minutes including pauses. Only the previous verified result passes to the next step. Enter a goal and preview a three-step draft. Each step receives the goal and the previous verified output only. Structural checks do not prove factual accuracy, code execution or quality. Applying replaces the editor, not a saved run.
Preview the current goal and template before applying.
Goal: %GOAL%. Propose an outline and list missing information; do not invent evidence. Use outline and missing arrays.
Goal: %GOAL%. Based on the previous outline and missing information, write a concise draft. Return draft and uncertainties.
Goal: %GOAL%. Review the previous draft for gaps and unsupported claims. Return a revised report and a checklist of unresolved checks.
Goal: %GOAL%. Break the goal into concrete tasks and dependencies. Do not claim execution.
Goal: %GOAL%. Use the preceding tasks and dependencies to draft an ordered plan and list risks.
Goal: %GOAL%. Review the plan and return prioritized actions and open questions. Do not claim tasks were performed.
Goal: %GOAL%. Identify requirements and test cases for a possible code solution.
Goal: %GOAL%. Draft code based on the previous requirements and tests, and state limitations. Do not claim to have executed it.
Goal: %GOAL%. Review the previous code for correctness and safety. Return revised code and a test plan, without claiming any tests ran.

Select 1–3 text, DOCX, XLSX or text PDF files. The local batch reads a bounded prefix of each file, splits up to 24 excerpts and synthesizes their notes. Text files use the selected common encoding; Office and PDF use their own formats. PDF text extraction requires Android 15 or later; scanned PDFs, images and OCR are not supported in batch mode. Only reviewed extracted text is analyzed. No chat record or original file is saved by this mode.
